name: zpro
customQuery:
SELECT 
  u.name,

  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) AS pendentes,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'open' THEN 1 END) AS atendendo,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'closed' THEN 1 END) AS finalizados,
  COUNT(t.id) AS total,

  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN te.evaluation ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' 
        THEN te.evaluation::numeric
      END
    ), 2
  ) AS media_avaliacoes

FROM "Users" u
LEFT JOIN "Tickets" t 
  ON t."userId" = u.id 
  AND t."tenantId" = 1
  AND t."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' -- 🔥 filtro aqui

LEFT JOIN "TicketEvaluations" te 
  ON te."ticketId" = t.id

WHERE 
  u."tenantId" = 1

GROUP BY u.name
ORDER BY u.name;
